newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent dates kept, one in dispute.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent dates kept, one in dispute.

text.p: Two of the Brent dates which turned wet on Thursday were kept by trading houses J.Aron and J.P. Morgan while a third was in dispute between BP and Glencore, traders said.
Two of the dates were deferred from Wednesday by Aron and BP, who were clocked with Dec 5-7 loaders.
The latest Brent deal was heard done at Dec Brent -48 cents for a prompt cargo loading Nov 28-30, down three cents from previous trades for early December cargoes, traders said.
